title: Accompanying Study Enhancing Palliative Care in ICU- Observational Study
summary:
The project is to be carried out as a subproject of the study EPIC (Europe-wide harmonized and recommended palliative care practice for ICU, https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT06605079) of the approved HORIZON funding application EPIC among the study participants of the Charité in order to assess the quality of intensive care and palliative care and to enable additional blood and plasma analyses. Palliative care quality indicators are not routinely recorded in intensive care medicine.
Two subprojects were approved in July 2026 : 1. Project to analyze structured documentation on patients and their families (Quality Indicator 8) 2. Feasibility study on the implementation of patient-reported outcomes to assess psychological distress in the intensive care unit
conditions: Mental and behavioural disorders due to use of sedatives or hypnotics: Withdrawal state with delirium

interventions.name:
All EPIC study patients in the participating Charité intensive care units (wards) should be offered participation in this accompanying scientific program by EPIC (https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT06605079, both in the control and intervention phases.
